content: Open Food Facts is crowdsourced: missing or incomplete nutrition fields are common and per-serving values only exist when serving_size exists. Live API check (product 5449000000996): base energy field is in kJ, kcal is a separate energy-kcal_100g key; '~' modifiers flag estimated values; fields can be entirely absent; nutrition_data_prepared_per distinguishes prepared-vs-as-sold values. Consumers must handle nulls, prefer _100g over _serving, and convert kJ to kcal.
